items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I SAW HIS WIDOW IN ST. LOUIS.

ctx.x: We knew half the time just what number we were going to rehearse each time and we would write out the brass section and maybe some of the reed section and some other guy would do the same thing and then we would get together and that's what we would call a head arranger and between that and a few of the ones that we eventually bought, they developed some marvelous things.
NOW DID JEETER START WITH THE BAND TOO.
